snippet.title: Mother;Above - VAINSANE Fridays #9 #visualnovel #psychologicalhorror
snippet.description:
VAINSANE Fridays #9 — Mother;Above

Matoki is about to flood to protect the inhabitants of the city above... Vik and his companions head for the flood controls, but his search for his missing mother threatens to consume him. A psychological horror VN about sacrifice, and what desperation makes people willing to do.

Part of VAINSANE Fridays, where I release a new bite-sized horror game every other Friday. Released September 11th, 2026.

Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5074900/MotherAbove/
